# Bundled OCR (Tesseract)

Served from this app instead of a CDN, so it works on networks that block CDNs and no third party sees any requests.

| File | From npm package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `tesseract.min.js`, `worker.min.js` | `tesseract.js@5.1.1` | Apache 2.0 (`LICENSE-tesseract.js.md`) |
| `core/tesseract-core-*-lstm.wasm.js` | `tesseract.js-core@5.1.1` | Apache 2.0 |
| `lang/eng.traineddata.gz` | `@tesseract.js-data/eng` (`4.0.0_best_int`) | Apache 2.0 |
